digest.component_or_area: prompt-cache effectiveness warning in structured LLM run
propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective fires whenever caching was requested and both cache counters are zero, with no lower bound on input_tokens.
Below the 4096-token cache floor, zero/zero cache counters are the correct expected result, so the warning false-alarms on small calls.
The warning fires roughly twenty times per review-plan gate run, causing alarm fatigue that masks the real opus-4-5 silent-cost-bleed defect it was built to catch.
The per-call warning contradicts the run's own aggregate telemetry, which shows cache_write_tokens greater than zero when caching engaged on larger calls.
The zero/zero cache result is a direct-Anthropic-path artifact, not a model capability; routing the same traffic through Bedrock caches correctly.
The floor constant CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS should have one shared definition used by both pass1.py and structured_run.py rather than a duplicated literal.
